description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notification in terms of Section 30 of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 1990 to determine the Market Rate of Interest with effect from 01st January 2021.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory determination by the Monetary Board regarding interest rates under the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework for debt recovery procedures rather than addressing government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The notification creates a binding regulatory requirement (market rate of interest) that falls under legal/regulatory matters.
